---
title: "Simple density"
description: "Fewer contours for a cleaner view, with scatter points underneath."
date: 2026-01-05
categories: [density]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-simple-density
#| fig-alt: "Simple density plot"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import soundscapy as sspy

data = pd.read_csv("../../assets/DemoData.csv")

sspy.density(
    data,
    title="Simple density plot",
    density_type="simple",
    diagonal_lines=True,
    incl_scatter=True,
)
plt.show()
```
